statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study, CPT code 93226, was ordered
The service was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes
Continuous rhythm monitoring is clinically necessary to characterize the arrhythmia associated with the patient's dizziness and to guide appropriate management
The diagnostic service is directly supported by the clinical indication and the patient's documented cardiac history
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
